name: United States
description: Follow United States, a tracked place, in Lootura: recent changes, timeline, related context, and source-backed evidence.

changes.title: The Uplift: The American Dream
changes.summary: We celebrate the United States ahead of its 250th anniversary with stories about American heroes and pastimes. The founder of e.l.f. Cosmetics shares how he made a massive life change to become a Catholic priest.

changes.title: How Jordan became a target for Iran in war with U.S.
changes.summary: Since the Iran war began in February, Jordan has largely avoided the kind of onslaught Tehran has aimed at places like Kuwait, Bahrain and the United Arab Emirates. With recent attacks, and one that killed three U.S. soldiers, that's changed. CBS News senior national security correspondent Charlie D'Agata examines why.

changes.title: How does Make America Healthy Again hold up against scientific scrutiny?
changes.summary: Nature, Published online: 23 July 2026; doi:10.1038/d41586-026-02024-3 Researchers share their views on the US health policy spanning topics from vaccines to nutrition.

changes.title: Trump is hellbent on tariffs. Here are 5 implications
changes.summary: Trump's determination to find new legal justifications for his tariffs threatens to prolong the uncertainty facing the U.S. and global economies. (Image credit: Tasos Katopodis).

changes.title: Utah, Known for Big Families, Leads the U.S. in Dropping Birthrates
changes.summary: Forget tradwives. When it comes to plummeting fertility rates, Utah is leading the country.

changes.title: Colombia’s Trump-Endorsed President-Elect Was Once Investigated by U.S. Authorities
changes.summary: While living in Miami, Colombia’s president-elect represented accused drug traffickers and money launderers. He himself was investigated by U.S. authorities, though never charged.

changes.title: Fact-checking Mullin's claim that foreign adversaries can access voting machines in U.S. elections
changes.summary: Mullin's comments about foreign adversaries accessing voting machines reflect concerns that security and election technology experts have long had. But so far, there's no proof of such attempts.

changes.title: Beluga whales transferred to U.S. aquariums after Canadian theme park closes
changes.summary: Nearly 30 beluga whales were sent to aquariums across the U.S. in a multinational emergency operation after their home aquarium in Canada shuttered. Jared Ochacher reports.

changes.summary: California Pizza Kitchen co-founder o joins "CBS Saturday Morning" to discuss the history of the franchise and his new memoir; "The California Pizza Kitchen Story: How Two Federal Prosecutors Changed the Way America Eats Pizza.".
